+## What
+Move the pins to FoundationModelsACP `27419fa` or later (alpha.7, `updates(for:)` removed) and FoundationModelsACPClient `a65af8a` or later (`ConnectionModel`, `SessionModel`; `ACPSessionState`, `SwiftUIACPClient` and the old `SessionEntry` removed). +
+**Start only when `a65af8a` is pushed to the remote `main` of FoundationModelsACPClient.** The build must stay green in this task, so it is a bridge: the views still bind to `AgentThread`. The later view tasks remove the bridge.
+
+- [ ] Read the real API of `ConnectionModel`, `SessionModel` and `TranscriptEntry` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/`). Correct update.md §4.2 and §4.3 where the names differ. +- [ ] Move the pins in the three `Package.resolved` files (root, `Benchmarks/`, the demo Xcode project). Pin each package to its revision; do not run a plain `swift package update`.

Feed `SessionUpdateMapping` from `SessionModel.updateTap()`. After the factory returns, seed the thread from the model state (`availableCommands`, `configOptions`, the transcript entries that arrived before the tap). Read the pending requests from `SessionModel.pendingPermissions` and `pendingElicitations`, and reply with their methods in `ACPThreadActions`.
+- [ ] Change `ACPSessionList` to `ConnectionModel.sessions`, `refreshSessions(cwd:)`, `loadMoreSessions()` and `hasMoreSessions`. Change `Sources/DemoSupport/ACPDemoSession.swift` and `Examples/ReadmeSnippets/Snippets/ACPQuickStart.swift` to `ConnectionModel` (no `updates(for:)`, no `SwiftUIACPClient`).
+- [ ] Change the ACP tests (`ACPThreadSourceTests`, `ACPThreadActionsTests`, `ACPSessionListTests`, `ProtocolVersionTests`, `ACPDemoSessionTests`) for the new API.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The three `Package.resolved` files pin the new revisions, and `ResolvedPinsTests` passes.
+- [ ] No source uses `ACPSessionState`, `SwiftUIACPClient` or `updates(for:)`.
+- [ ] A resume shows the replayed history in the thread.
+- [ ] `swift test`, `Scripts/check-readme.sh`, `Scripts/check-benchmarks.sh` and `Scripts/test-examples.sh AgentViewKitDemo` pass.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `ACPThreadSourceTests`: with `ScriptedWireAgent`, a prompt shows the user message and the agent message (the agent sends `messageId`); a resume with history shows the replayed entries.
+- [ ] Add `ACPSessionList` tests against `ConnectionModel` with two pages.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m46gsf6hx07qeecsfck0rz9z
+  text: |-
+    Research done.
+
+    - The remote heads: FoundationModelsACP `fe0d82d` (only kanban commits after `27419fa`, no source change), FoundationModelsACPClient `be7e615` (only kanban commits after `a65af8a`, no source change). The task pins these two heads.
+    - `ConnectionModel.connect(over:)` returns the `ClientSideConnection`, but the model keeps it internal. Thus `ACPThreadActions` sends through the models: `SessionModel.prompt`, `cancel`, `setConfigOption`, the pending reply methods, and `ConnectionModel.login`/`logout`. `logout` needs `canLogout`, so the test harness sends `initialize` with an agent auth method.
+    - `resumeSession(_:)` needs `canResumeSessions` (a `session` capability object in the `initialize` answer). It runs the whole replay before it returns. Thus the replayed entries are in `SessionModel.transcript`, not in a later `updateTap()`. The source seeds the thread from the transcript (after `flushPendingChunks()`), then reads the tap. Each transcript entry becomes one whole-entry `SessionUpdate` (user message, agent message, thought, tool call, terminal, plan, unknown, compaction), so `SessionUpdateMapping` stays the one mapping.
+    - `ResumeSessionRequest.replayFrom` is `ReplayFrom.start(ReplayFromStart)`.
+    - `ACPSessionListTests` also use `SwiftUIACPClient` only to connect. They change to `ConnectionModel`.
+  timestamp: 2026-10-05T17:11:41.009757+00:00

The update also moved swift-log 1.15.0 to 1.15.1 and Noora 0.57.2 to 0.57.1, because the client requires them.
+    - **FoundationModelsExtras had to move too.** The client at `be7e615` uses `TracedCall` and `SpanIdentity` of FoundationModelsExtras, and the old Extras pin `8ec26d4` does not have them (the build failed). I moved Extras to its remote head `130eb40` (`swift package update FoundationModelsExtras`). Each Extras revision with `TracedCall` also brings MLX (`mlx-swift`, `mlx-swift-lm`, `swift-transformers`, and others) as transitive packages, so a clean build is longer and shows C++ warnings from `.build/checkouts/mlx-swift`. These warnings are in a dependency, not in the kit.
+    - **The demo `Package.resolved` is git-ignored.** It is in the generated `AgentViewKitDemo.xcodeproj`, and `Examples/Scripts/xcodeproj_generator.rb` copies the root file into it. A clean checkout (the CI `swift test` job) has no such file. The owner chose this shape: `ResolvedPinsTests` always reads the root and `Benchmarks/` files, reads the demo file only when the generated project exists (`.enabled(if:)`), and always checks that the generator copies the root file. I also copied the root file into the local demo project.
+    - `ResolvedPinsTests` reuses `ResolvedFile` of `ManifestTests.swift`, which now also decodes `branch` and `revision`.
+    - `ConnectionModel` keeps its `ClientSideConnection` internal. Thus `ACPThreadActions` now takes `session: SessionModel` and `connection: ConnectionModel` and sends through them (`prompt`, `cancel`, `setConfigOption`, `selectPermission`/`cancelPermission`, the elicitation replies, `login`/`logout`). `SessionModel.setConfigOption(_:)` returns nothing; the agent reports the options in a `config_option_update`, so the verb no longer puts the response options on the thread. The test `setConfigOptionSendsTheValueAndReplacesTheOptions` became `setConfigOptionSendsTheValue`, and `setConfigOptionThatFailsAddsAnErrorRecord` is new.
+    - `ACPThreadSource` has a new `init(thread:session:agentName:)` and the factories `openNewSession(_:on:thread:agentName:)` and `resumeSession(_:cwd:on:thread:agentName:)` (the second sends `replayFrom: .start`). The init flushes the chunk buffer, seeds the thread with `TranscriptSeed` (new file `Sources/AgentViewKit/ACP/TranscriptSeed.swift`: one whole-entry update for each transcript entry, an error record for each `ErrorEntry`, and the last-value state), and then takes `updateTap()`. `initialize(over:)` now takes a `ConnectionModel`. `mirrorPendingRequests(of:)` takes a `SessionModel`.
+    - `ScriptedWireAgent` has a new `leadIns` (frames before the answer), so that a test can send a resume replay before the resume answer.
+    - `ACPSessionListTests` also used `SwiftUIACPClient` to connect; it uses `ConnectionModel` now. `ACPSessionList.swift` is not changed.
